summary: Braskem S.A. furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a related-party natural gas supply amendment between its wholly owned subsidiary Voqen Energia Ltda. (buyer) and Petrobras (seller), a co-controlling shareholder. The amendment extends the firm, non-flexible contract term from December 31, 2026 to December 31, 2029, raises contractual daily quantity to a 300,000-1,000,000 m3/day range, and lifts estimated contract value to BRL 1.85 billion. Transaction dated August 28, 2026; reviewed by Voqen bodies, audit and finance committees, executive officers, and approved by Braskem's Board, including Petrobras-affiliated directors. Watch related-party approval and governance risk.
